listing.title: Appstore
listing.description:
Appstore is an open-source Android app store that scans six sources and merges them into one feed: GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, APKPure and Aptoide. No ads and no bloat.

Find what you want faster
- Browse curated categories plus smart sections such as Trending and Newly Launched.
- See screenshots pulled straight from each project's README.
- Sync your GitHub starred repositories into your favourites.

Install with confidence
- Every downloaded APK is checked against the signing certificate of the app already on your phone before it installs, so a hijacked repository or redirected release cannot silently replace what you have.
- Your install history is kept, and you can roll back to a previous version from it.

Made for everyone
- Available in 16 languages, including English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic and Chinese.
- Dismissible in-app announcements for releases and community updates.
- Optional Liquid Glass Pro themes.

Appstore is open source under the AGPL-3.0 licence.

apps.summary: Open-source Android store merging GitHub, F-Droid, Aptoide and more

reviews.body: I've been hunting through GitHub release pages for months 😩 and this just puts everything in one place. Tapped install and it picked the right APK for my phone first time 🙌
No ads. No tracking. No "create an account" nonsense. In 2026?? I had to double check I wasn't dreaming 😂
Update notifications are the killer feature for me 🔔 Got pinged about a new release before I even knew one was coming. Never going back to manual checking.
Dark mode is gorgeous 🌙 and the compare-two-apps view saved me from picking the wrong one. Only wish the trust score explained itself a bit more 🤔
An update broke my favourite app and I nearly panicked 😬 then found the rollback option. Back to the old version in 10 seconds. You've earned a fan 💯
Great idea, honestly, but a lot of listings have no screenshots 📷 and search crawled on my mobile data 🐌 Fix those and it's a 5 for me.
Synced my GitHub stars into favourites and my whole wishlist appeared instantly ✨ Would love more categories for dev tools.
Open source, free, respects privacy. I sent it to my whole class group chat and three people have already installed it 🥳
Use it daily now. It feels like a proper Play Store alternative but without the baggage ❤️ Please keep it this clean!
Was skeptical at first 🤨 then I saw the signature check and the install history. Okay, this is legit. Five stars, no notes 🔥

listing.title: BitChord
listing.description:
BitChord is an aesthetic YouTube Music client for Android, built for people who care how their music app looks and feels.

Features:
- Stream from YouTube Music with a clean, modern interface
- Synchronized lyrics with word-by-word highlighting
- Offline downloads for tracks, albums and playlists
- Background playback with full media notification controls
- Queue management with reordering and play-next
- Spotify and Discord integration
- Apple Music inspired and Material You themes
- No ads, no tracking, no account required to start

BitChord is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to YouTube or Google in any way.

apps.summary: Aesthetic YouTube Music client with synced lyrics and offline playback

reviews.body: The UI is gorgeous. Apple Music vibes with YouTube Music's library, best of both.
Lyrics sync perfectly and offline downloads actually work. Ditched the official app.
Beautiful themes, though I wish there were more playlist import options.
Discord integration is such a nice touch. Music status updates just work.
Solid player. Took me a minute to find the queue reorder but it's there.
No ads, no nonsense, gorgeous design. My daily driver now.
Great look but occasional stutter on my older phone. Still worth it.
Spotify integration sealed it for me. Switched over completely.

listing.title: Flow
listing.description:
Flow (YouTube-X) is a privacy-first YouTube and YouTube Music client. It provides a personalized feed using a completely local, on-device algorithm, giving you a modern discovery experience without tracking or accounts.

Features:
- Play videos and songs from YouTube and YouTube Music
- Local recommendation engine that learns your preferences on-device
- 100% on-device privacy with zero analytics or tracking
- No Google account required
- Background audio and Picture-in-Picture video playback
- Built-in SponsorBlock to automatically skip sponsored segments
- Built-in DeArrow to replace clickbait titles and thumbnails
- Built-in Return YouTube Dislike
- Download videos and audio for offline playback
- Dedicated music player with synchronized live lyrics
- Import subscriptions, playlists and history from YouTube, NewPipe and LibreTube

Flow keeps your recommendations and watch history entirely on your own device.

apps.summary: Privacy-first YouTube and Music client with local recommendations

reviews.body: Finally a YouTube client that doesn't send my watch history anywhere. Respect.
SponsorBlock built in means I never hear a mattress ad again. Glorious.
Local recommendations are surprisingly decent after a week of use.
DeArrow alone is worth the install. No more shocked-face thumbnails.
PiP works great. Wish the music player had a few more equalizer presets.
Imported my whole LibreTube setup in one go. Seamless.
No account needed and it just works. This is how it should be.
Privacy-first and functional. Slight lag when scrolling large feeds.
Great concept, but downloads sometimes fail on flaky wifi.

listing.title: Echo Music
listing.description:
Echo Music delivers a seamless, premium listening experience built on YouTube Music's vast library, without the ads. It adds powerful extras including offline downloads, real-time synchronized lyrics, and environment-aware music recognition.

Features:
- Ad-Free: stream without any interruptions
- Seamless Playback: switch effortlessly between audio-only and video modes
- Background Playback: listen while using other apps or with the screen off
- Offline Mode: download tracks, albums and playlists through a dedicated download manager
- Echo Find: identify songs playing around you using advanced audio recognition
- Multiple Lyric Animations: word-by-word synchronized display styles
- Smart Recommendations: personalized suggestions based on your listening history
- Echo Brain: an intelligent, on-device engine that analyzes your taste locally
- Material You and Liquid Glass themes that adapt to your wallpaper
- Light, Dark and AMOLED modes

Your listening history stays on your device. Echo Music never phones home with what you play.

apps.summary: Ad-free music streaming with synced lyrics and offline playback

reviews.body: Echo Find is magic. It identified a song playing in a cafe within seconds.
Ad-free and the lyrics animations are stunning. Battery life is great too.
Echo Brain recommendations are scarily good. Minor sync hiccup once.
The Liquid Glass theme is the prettiest thing on my phone right now.
Offline downloads work flawlessly. Would love a desktop version.
Finally a music app that respects privacy AND looks premium.
Recognition feature is genuinely useful. Small learning curve on settings.
Word-by-word lyrics are perfectly timed. Chef's kiss.
Good app but the library scan is slow on first launch with big collections.

listing.title: Last-wave
listing.description:
LastWave is a next-generation YouTube Music client with an algorithmic smart playlist generator, real-time synced lyrics and a universal Last.fm scrobbler for Android.

Features:
- Stream from YouTube Music with an ad-free experience
- Smart Playlist Generator that builds mixes from your listening habits
- Real-time synchronized lyrics with word-level timing
- Universal Last.fm scrobbling
- Offline downloads and caching for playback without a connection
- Background playback with full notification controls
- Audio effects: equalizer, bass boost, tempo and pitch control
- Sleep timer and gapless playback
- Material You dynamic theming
- Light, Dark and AMOLED themes
- Import playlists and library from other clients

LastWave is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

apps.summary: YouTube Music client with smart playlists and synced lyrics

reviews.body: The smart playlist generator actually understands my taste. Uncanny.
Last.fm scrobbling works perfectly. Every play gets logged.
Beautiful app. The lyric timing is spot on most of the time.
Algorithmic mixes replaced my Spotify Discover Weekly entirely.
Great sound quality options. Tempo control is handy for workouts.
AMOLED theme is gorgeous and saves battery on my phone.
Solid client. Occasionally needs a restart after long sessions.
Imported all my playlists without a single hiccup. Impressed.

listing.title: Metrolist
listing.description:
Metrolist is a Material 3 YouTube Music client for Android.

Features:
- Play any song or video from YouTube Music
- Background playback
- Personalized quick picks
- Library management
- Download and cache songs for offline playback
- Search for songs, albums, artists, videos and playlists
- Live lyrics
- YouTube Music account login support
- Syncing of songs, artists, albums and playlists, to and from your account
- Skip silence
- Import playlists
- Audio normalization
- Adjust tempo and pitch

- Reorder songs in a playlist or the queue

Metrolist is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

apps.summary: Material 3 YouTube Music client for Android

reviews.body: Material 3 done right. Looks like it shipped with my Pixel.
Login and library sync work flawlessly. My playlists came across instantly.
Audio normalization is a lifesaver for my old playlists.
Tempo and pitch control without distortion. Very well engineered.
Skip silence is such a small feature that makes a huge difference.
Clean and fast. Would love widgets on the home screen.
Imported my YouTube Music library perfectly. Never looking back.
Sleep timer works great. Minor issue with the queue after a reboot.
Good app overall but search occasionally returns stale results.

listing.title: Velune
listing.description:
Velune is a premium ad-free YouTube Music client for Android built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

Features:
- Ad-free YouTube Music playback
- Background playback with battery optimization
- Personalized Quick Picks and Keep Listening sections
- Offline caching and downloads for playback without internet
- Synced word-by-word lyrics with translation support
- Material You dynamic theming that adapts to album art colors
- Search for songs, albums, artists, playlists and videos
- YouTube Music account login and library sync
- Import playlists from YouTube Music
- Gapless playback and crossfade
- Silence skipping
- Audio normalization (EBU R128)
- Tempo and pitch control
- Sleep timer
- Discord Rich Presence integration
- Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling
- Light, Dark, AMOLED and Dynamic themes
- Customizable home feed

Velune is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

apps.summary: Premium ad-free YouTube Music client for Android

reviews.body: Premium feel all around. The dynamic theming from album art is beautiful.
Discord Rich Presence and Last.fm scrobbling in one app? Instant install.
Gapless playback is perfect. Crossfade could use a bit more tuning.
Crossfade and silence skipping make albums flow beautifully.
The home feed customization is exactly what I wanted from a music client.
Beautiful design, battery optimization genuinely works.
Lyrics with translation support is a killer feature for foreign tracks.
Very polished. Occasional hiccup syncing a large library.
